'''Dagondeep''' is a [[Water]] type [[Support]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Armorjaw]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "Dagondeep is the living tide, a presence that haunts dreams with quiet terror. An ancient body encased in layered scales of armor, each movement echoes the tremors of R'lyeh. Now, the webbed hand beckons: Come, master. There is no need to breathe beneath the sea... and the rent is far cheaper."

Dagondeep is a rainbow rarity Tatari that acts as a frontline AoE bruiser, inflicting a debuff to reduce incoming damage. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

== Appearance ==
big feeeesh

Armorjaw's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form recolors its blue fins to a teal color.

== Strategy ==
[[File:Dagondeep Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Dagondeep's Attack Range]]
Tidesurge: Weak reduces the damage that Zobos deal, helping Dagondeep stay alive while dealing damage.
